title: How do birds build their nests?
examples: What do birds make nests from?
Do birds learn how to build nests?
What is the biggest bird nest?

explain.say: Birds build nests to keep their eggs and chicks warm, dry and hidden. Different birds build very different nests, from twigs, grass, mud, moss and even spider silk.

draw.text: How do birds build their nests?

explain.say: Many birds shape a cup by sitting in the nest and turning round and round, pressing outwards with their breast and feet. Then they line it with soft feathers, fur or moss to hold in warmth.

explain.say: Weaverbirds tie real knots, weaving strips of grass into hanging nests with the entrance underneath, hard for snakes to reach. Young males get better with practice, so building is partly learned, not pure instinct.
Nests range from hummingbird cups the size of a walnut shell, bound with stretchy spider silk, to bald eagle nests a couple of metres wide that are reused and added to for years.

faq.q: What do birds make nests from?
faq.a: Birds use whatever suits their nest: twigs and sticks for strength, grass and roots for weaving, mud as cement, moss and lichen for camouflage, and feathers, fur or wool for a soft, warm lining. Some even use spider silk or bits of plastic.

faq.q: Do birds learn how to build nests?
faq.a: Partly. Birds have an instinct to build, but experience helps: young weaverbirds drop fewer strands and build better nests as they practise, and birds can change materials after a failed nest.
asks: Do young birds build worse nests?

faq.q: Why do hummingbirds use spider silk?
faq.a: Spider silk is strong, sticky and stretchy. Hummingbirds bind their tiny cups with it, so the nest holds together and stretches as the chicks grow.

Why do birds steal spider webs?

faq.q: What is the biggest bird nest?
faq.a: The largest recorded single nest, built by bald eagles in Florida, was about 2.9 metres wide and 6 metres deep and weighed around two tonnes. Sociable weavers build huge shared nests with rooms for many pairs.
asks: How big is an eagle nest?

faq.a: No. Many shorebirds lay eggs in a simple scrape on the ground, emperor penguins hold their egg on their feet, and cuckoos lay their eggs in other birds' nests.
